inv.desc_en:
30 M2 COMMERCIAL SPACE, VERY WELL LOCATED IN HUERTA DE LA SALUD, WITH A LARGE DISPLAY WINDOW, SUITABLE FOR A MEDICAL OFFICE, CLOTHING STORE, BEAUTY SALON, OR NAIL SALON. IN PERFECT CONDITION. Do not miss this opportunity. Visit this property without obligation and discover for yourself the potential it offers!
Do not hesitate to visit us at our offices in Nervión, Avenida de Eduardo Dato 24, ground floor, near the corner of Avenida San Francisco Javier, or explore our website.
For more information and to arrange a visit, please do not hesitate to contact us at 954 58 00 20.
We offer you a wide range of services to facilitate the rental process of your property.
We guide you throughout the entire rental process, from property selection to contract signing.
With more than two decades of continuous experience, we are dedicated to bringing happiness to your life through real estate investment.
At Guadalquivir Inmobiliaria, our two fundamental pillars are professionalism and trust, which we always put at your service.
Trust Guadalquivir Inmobiliaria to make your dreams come true.
In compliance with the Decree of the Regional Government of Andalusia 218-2005 of October 11, we remind you that as a consumer, you have the right to be informed and provided with the corresponding informative documentation, as the case may be, based on the provisions of Decree 218/05 of October 11, which regulates the Consumer Information Regulations for the sale and rental of homes in Andalusia.
